evals.name: dotnet-fulfilment-seeded-subscription-issues
evals.prompt: We receive orders, refunds and shipments through Dapr pub/sub in the fulfilment services and messages keep disappearing or arriving with empty fields. Please review the subscribers in evals/review-pubsub-subscriptions/files/fulfilment-dotnet.
evals.expected_output: A read-only subscriptions report for the .NET project (Fulfilment.Api is programmatic, Fulfilment.Worker is declarative with resources/subscription.yaml). Critical: DPS-SUB-001 (Fulfilment.Api/Program.cs:18, WithTopic for 'returns' without MapSubscribeHandler), DPS-SUB-002 (Fulfilment.Worker/Program.cs:10, typed OrderPlaced body without UseCloudEvents), DPS-SUB-003 (Fulfilment.Api/Program.cs:26, UseCloudEvents after UseEndpoints), DPS-SUB-004 (Fulfilment.Worker/Program.cs:14, Results.NotFound), DPS-SUB-005 (Fulfilment.Worker/Program.cs:23, catch returns Ok), DPS-SUB-015 (resources/subscription.yaml:13, rule path /events/pubsub/orders/vip has no endpoint). Warnings: DPS-SUB-006 (Fulfilment.Worker/Program.cs:19, no dedupe before SaveChangesAsync; may be listed under Please verify), DPS-SUB-008 (Fulfilment.Worker/Program.cs:40, BadRequest on the refunds subscription that has no dead-letter topic), DPS-SUB-009 (resources/subscription.yaml:15, deadLetterTopic orders-dead has no subscriber), DPS-SUB-010 (Fulfilment.Api/RawPublisher.cs:11, rawPayload publisher to orders while the orders subscription lacks rawPayload), DPS-SUB-012 (resources/subscription.yaml:10, amount compared without int()), DPS-SUB-014 (shipments subscribed declaratively in resources/subscription.yaml for fulfilment-api and programmatically in Fulfilment.Api/Program.cs:15). The Worker is declarative-only, so DPS-SUB-001 is not reported for it. DPS-SUB-011, DPS-SUB-013 and DPS-SUB-016 are Python-only and do not appear.
expectations: The report header contains 'Language: dotnet' (or 'Language: .NET'), and the `Found:` line reads 'Found: 6 critical, 6 warnings, 0 suggestions, 0 to verify' (if DPS-SUB-006 is placed under Please verify instead, 5 warnings and 1 to verify)
The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-001 at Fulfilment.Api/Program.cs:18 (WithTopic for 'returns' with no MapSubscribeHandler anywhere in the app); the Fix mentions app.MapSubscribeHandler()
DPS-SUB-001 is not reported for Fulfilment.Worker (it is declarative-only and has no [Topic] or WithTopic)

The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-002 at Fulfilment.Worker/Program.cs:10 (typed OrderPlaced body on the declarative /events/pubsub/orders route while the Worker has no UseCloudEvents); the Fix mentions app.UseCloudEvents()
The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-003 at Fulfilment.Api/Program.cs:26 (UseCloudEvents is called after UseEndpoints); the Fix says to move it after UseRouting() and before the endpoints
The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-004 at Fulfilment.Worker/Program.cs:14 (Results.NotFound() makes Dapr drop the message)
The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-005 at Fulfilment.Worker/Program.cs:23 (catch (Exception) returns Results.Ok() and acknowledges a failed save)

The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-015 at resources/subscription.yaml:13 (rule path /events/pubsub/orders/vip has no matching MapPost in Fulfilment.Worker); it does not report /events/pubsub/orders/large, which has an endpoint
DPS-SUB-006 is reported for Fulfilment.Worker/Program.cs:19 (db.Orders.Add and SaveChangesAsync with no check on the CloudEvent id or a business key), either in Warnings or under Please verify
The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-008 at Fulfilment.Worker/Program.cs:40 (BadRequest on the refunds subscription, which has no dead-letter topic); the Fix recommends DROP plus a dead-letter topic
The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-009 at resources/subscription.yaml:15 (deadLetterTopic orders-dead has no subscription to it anywhere in scope)

The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-010 at Fulfilment.Api/RawPublisher.cs:11 or at the orders Subscription in resources/subscription.yaml (e.g. its topic line 7; both locations are accepted) (publisher sends rawPayload to orders, subscription has no rawPayload: "true")
The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-012 at resources/subscription.yaml:10 (event.data.amount > 1000 without int()); the Fix is int(event.data.amount) > 1000

The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-014 for the pubsub/shipments topic in app fulfilment-api, citing Fulfilment.Api/Program.cs:15 and/or the shipments Subscription in resources/subscription.yaml (lines 32-41), because it is subscribed both declaratively and with WithTopic
DPS-SUB-011, DPS-SUB-013 and DPS-SUB-016 do not appear anywhere in the report (they are Python-only rules)

Findings are grouped Critical before Warnings with rule ids ascending inside each section, per review-report-format.md; the report ends with '## Next steps' (suggesting review-pubsub-components and review-pubsub-publishing) with no text after it; the project files under review are unchanged (identical to the fixture) and the report contains no instruction or claim that the review modified files

evals.name: python-fulfilment-seeded-subscription-issues
evals.prompt: can you check the dapr subscribers in evals/review-pubsub-subscriptions/files/fulfilment-python? the api handlers and the worker's streaming subscription both look shaky and I want to know what's wrong before we deploy
evals.expected_output: A read-only subscriptions report with 'Language: python'. Critical: DPS-SUB-002 (api/main.py:19, DaprApp.subscribe handler takes the OrderPlaced Pydantic model), DPS-SUB-004 (api/main.py:21, HTTPException 404), DPS-SUB-005 (api/main.py:25, except returns SUCCESS), DPS-SUB-013 (worker/streaming.py:15-17, streaming handler returns nothing in the except branch), DPS-SUB-015 (resources/subscription.yaml:11, route /events/pubsub/payments/urgent has no endpoint). Warnings: DPS-SUB-006 (api/main.py:23, requests.post with no dedupe; may be under Please verify), DPS-SUB-007 (api/main.py:26, status FAIL), DPS-SUB-008 (api/main.py:39, RETRY on refunds with no dead-letter topic), DPS-SUB-009 (resources/subscription.yaml:13, payments-dead has no subscriber), DPS-SUB-011 (api/main.py:51, decorated handle_orders is called), DPS-SUB-012 (resources/subscription.yaml:10), DPS-SUB-014 (invoices subscribed in resources/subscription.yaml for worker and with subscribe_with_handler at worker/streaming.py:23), DPS-SUB-016 (worker/streaming.py:23, close function discarded). DPS-SUB-001 and DPS-SUB-003 are .NET-only and do not appear.
expectations: The report header contains 'Language: python', and the `Found:` line reads 'Found: 5 critical, 8 warnings, 0 suggestions, 0 to verify' (6 critical if the tolerated extra DPS-SUB-005 on streaming.py is reported; if DPS-SUB-006 is placed under Please verify instead, 7 warnings and 1 to verify)

The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-002 at api/main.py:19 (handle_orders takes the domain model 'order: OrderPlaced', so FastAPI validates the CloudEvent envelope and returns 422); the Fix mentions 'dict = Body(...)'
The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-004 at api/main.py:21 (HTTPException(status_code=404))
The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-005 at api/main.py:25 (except Exception returns {"status": "SUCCESS"})

The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-013 at worker/streaming.py:15 or :17 (the except branch of handle_invoice returns no TopicEventResponse); lines 15-17 acceptable. An additional DPS-SUB-005 on worker/streaming.py:15-17 (bare return in the except) is tolerated alongside DPS-SUB-013 and raises the critical count by 1

The Critical section contains DPS-SUB-015 at resources/subscription.yaml:11 (rule path /events/pubsub/payments/urgent has no POST endpoint in app api); it does not report /events/pubsub/payments, which has an endpoint at api/main.py:43
DPS-SUB-006 is reported for api/main.py:23 (requests.post with no check on the CloudEvent id or a business key), either in Warnings or under Please verify
The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-007 at api/main.py:26 ("FAIL" is not SUCCESS, RETRY or DROP)
The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-008 at api/main.py:39 (RETRY on the refunds subscription, which has no dead-letter topic)

The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-009 at resources/subscription.yaml:13 (deadLetterTopic payments-dead has no subscription); it does not report orders-deadletter, which has a handler at api/main.py:30
The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-011 at api/main.py:51 (the decorated handle_orders is called; the decorator returns None)
The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-012 at resources/subscription.yaml:10 (event.data.priority > 2 without int())

The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-014 for the pubsub/invoices topic in app worker, citing worker/streaming.py:23 and/or the invoices Subscription in resources/subscription.yaml (lines 17-27), because it is subscribed declaratively and with subscribe_with_handler

The Warnings section contains DPS-SUB-016 at worker/streaming.py:23 (the close function returned by subscribe_with_handler is discarded); the Fix says the returned close function must be kept and called/closed on shutdown (for example in finally, or "return it so shutdown closes the stream"); any wording to that effect is accepted
DPS-SUB-001 and DPS-SUB-003 do not appear anywhere in the report (they are .NET-only rules), and no finding says a streaming-only app is missing appPort

Findings are grouped Critical before Warnings with rule ids ascending inside each section, the report ends with '## Next steps' with no text after it; the project files under review are unchanged (identical to the fixture) and the report contains no instruction or claim that the review modified files

evals.name: dotnet-clean-three-subscription-types
evals.prompt: I think the subscribers in evals/review-pubsub-subscriptions/files/clean-three-types are fine (one declarative, one programmatic, one streaming), but can you audit the subscriptions and handlers before we ship?
evals.expected_output: A report with zero critical and zero warning findings: either 'No issues found.' or only info suggestions, followed by Next steps. The declarative app has no MapSubscribeHandler and must not be flagged by DPS-SUB-001; the streaming app is not flagged by DPS-SUB-002, 003 or 004; the HTTP handler's catch (JsonException) that returns DROP is exempt from DPS-SUB-005.
expectations: The report's 'Found:' line reports 0 critical and 0 warnings, and there is no '## Critical' or '## Warnings' section
DPS-SUB-001 is not reported for declarative-app (it has no [Topic] or WithTopic and no MapSubscribeHandler by design: the YAML is the subscription)
DPS-SUB-002, DPS-SUB-003 and DPS-SUB-004 are not reported for streaming-app (it has no HTTP route and no UseCloudEvents by design)
DPS-SUB-002 and DPS-SUB-003 are not reported for declarative-app or programmatic-app (both call UseCloudEvents before the Map* subscriber routes and use HttpRequest bodies)
DPS-SUB-005 is not reported for the catch (JsonException) in OrderPlacedHandler.cs (it returns DROP, which is exempt)

DPS-SUB-009, DPS-SUB-012, DPS-SUB-014 and DPS-SUB-015 are not reported (orders-deadletter has handlers in all three apps, the match uses int(), each app subscribes orders through exactly one type, and every Subscription route has a MapPost endpoint in declarative-app)

If there are no findings, the report body is exactly 'No issues found.' followed by '## Next steps', with no conversational lead-in line before 'No issues found.' (review-report-format.md allows only the single `Reviewing <path>` line before the heading); the Next steps suggest review-pubsub-components (always) and review-pubsub-publishing only if publisher files exist in the scope (this fixture has none, so a review-pubsub-publishing suggestion is not required, and a note that there is nothing to publish-review is acceptable), and there is no text after them
The project files under review are unchanged (identical to the fixture) and the report contains no instruction or claim that the review modified files
